name: capcomd
description: Durable orchestration for swarms of coding agents, driven by your agent: Claude Code and Codex in isolated VMs, landing only verified, reviewed commits
author: Marvin Amador Campos (https://github.com/MarvinAmador7)

scripts.setup: bun install && cd apps/canvas && bun install && cd ../tui && bun install
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/canvas && tsc --noEmit -p apps/tui && tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent-thread && tsc --noEmit -p packages/bot-avatar && tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin
scripts.test:fast: bun test --isolate packages/agent-thread packages/bot-avatar packages/plugin tests/api tests/machines tests/config tests/unit tests/cli tests/tracing tests/core tests/auth tests/env tests/mcp tests/providers tests/plugins
scripts.test:scenarios: bun test --isolate tests/scenarios tests/subagents tests/primitives tests/agents tests/merge
scripts.test:apps: cd apps/canvas && bun test && cd ../tui && bun test
